description: Reshare (repost) an existing LinkedIn post to your feed, optionally with commentary

commentary.description: Optional commentary shown above the reshare (max 3000 characters)

parent.description: URN of the post to reshare, e.g. 'urn:li:share:123456' or 'urn:li:ugcPost:123456'

visibility.description: Reshare visibility (default: PUBLIC). CONNECTIONS is only valid for personal accounts.

name: linkedin_create_reshare
title: LinkedIn: repost/reshare a post
